title: This Weekend in South Florida: Football, Boats, and Easy Plans
igCaption:
Football, boats, art, and a Carrie prom in one South Florida weekend.

Sources: BOAT International, Boating Mag, Daily Jefferson County Union, New York Times, Miami New Times

#Miami #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #WeekendGuide

scenes.text: What do boats, No. 1 Miami football, and a Carrie-themed prom have in common this weekend?

The Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show is back for 2026. BOAT International calls it the world’s largest in-water boat show. Boating Mag’s Friday guide points people toward the new boats to see, so expect the docks to do a lot of the talking.

scenes.text: Miami hosts Pittsburgh on Saturday, October 24. The Hurricanes are ranked No. 1, and they’re paying tribute to the 2001 national championship team. Miami reached No. 1 for the first time in nearly a quarter-century.

scenes.text: Room 901 in Fort Lauderdale is doing a Carrie takeover through Halloween. It sits inside Hyatt Centric Las Olas at 100 E. Las Olas Blvd. The setup marks 50 years after Carrie White’s prom night went wrong. If you're at Room 901, check NEAR to see who else showed up.

scenes.text: Family Fest 2026 happens Sunday at ICA Miami Expansion Space. It starts at 1 p.m. at 23 NE 41st St. Tickets cost $50 for adults, $15 for kids, and children under 3 enter free.
